description: Picks apart someone else's repo, skill, plugin, MCP server or agent harness to find which of its parts fit this workspace, collates the options on that topic into a topic guide in your notes, and records every thing looked at in a ledger so nothing is evaluated twice. Use when the user drops a link or a list of links and asks if it is useful, worth adding, worth stealing or worth looking at, says "eval this", "vet these", "should I install this", "is this worth it", "what's out there for X", or points at a note full of tools to triage; also before adopting any external tool found mid-task. Dedupes against past verdicts first. Do NOT use to install anything, to search for prior art while building (that is /outside), or for things not built for or about AI agents (those go to a general dev-tools note).
